content.text: The insurance clause fully meets the preferred position.

input.quote: Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 meets the preferred position in full: CGL at USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, E&O at USD 2M and cyber/privacy liability at USD 5M, maintained throughout the term and for one year afterward, with certificates of insurance available on request (§ 18.2). The clause also adds employer's liability of USD 1M and confirms insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities, both of which favour us. Only minor point, noted but not flagged: advance notice of cancellation or material reduction is qualified by "to the extent available from its insurer", and policies are primary to our insurance only "where commercially customary" — sub-elements short of ideal wording that do not affect the material limits. No redline required.
